content:
**Picklock** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*, and was a perk in the Nuclear Winter battle royale mode. It replaces the functionality of the Locksmith perk in *Fallout 4*.

Locked doors and containers require a lockpicking skill ranging from 0 to 3 to attempt lockpicking. When equipped, Picklock increases this skill by 1, as well as increases the range of the 'sweet spot' by 10%.

When equipped with one of the other two lockpicking perk cards, Expert Picklock and Master Picklock, player characters can attempt to lockpick skill level 2 locks. With all three perk cards equipped, player characters can attempt to lockpick skill level 3 locks. Duplicate perk cards cannot be equipped to increase the lockpicking skill.
